name: Azzinoth's Assault extends Inner Demon's duration (#4664)
contract: Azzinoth's Assault (803472) tooltip reads (conditional on Inner Demon): 'Extends the duration of Inner
Demon by $/1000;803089s1 sec.' 803472's own DBC effects only trigger its two weapon hits (520262, 572585);
EffectBonusMultiplier 0.4 = AP scaling) was never cast by 803472 anywhere, and even if it had been,
SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_DURATION (177) had no registered handler in src/server/coa for
Felsworn, unlike the same custom effect on Reaper/Witch Hunter/Venomancer. The fix (a) casts 803089 from
felsworn_casts::OnSpellHitResult when 803472 lands on a hostile target while Inner Demon is active, and
(b) registers a SpellEffectFn on 803089's EFFECT_0 (following the exact Reaper/Venomancer pattern) that
calls AscensionFelsworn::Extend, the same helper already used for Inner Demon's stack-based duration, with
GetEffectValue() - a new FelswornCoefficients row (803089, effect 0, ap 0.4) feeds the AP scaling through
the same ModifySpellEffectBaseValue hook the class already uses for every other AP/SP-scaled effect, so
GetEffectValue() resolves the DBC's full 3000ms-plus-AP formula. Inner Demon's own max duration is 5000ms
per Felfury stack (OnCalcMaxDuration); fixturing 2 Felfury before casting Inner Demon gives a known
10000ms baseline duration to extend from. The parent 803472 and both weapon strikes are DmgClass MELEE
(2), so the duration fixture uses melee hit/expertise, both original one-handed weapon slots and trained
native weapon skills. Spell hit does not remove its melee miss/dodge/parry rolls. The helper must actually
cast, both weapon strikes must deal damage, and the original independent duration-extension lower bound

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Native melee accuracy applies to the authored Melee attack
Native expertise covers melee dodge and parry
Fixture 2 Felfury so Inner Demon's max duration is a known 10000ms
SETUP: Inner Demon is active at the 2-stack duration
The duration-extension helper is cast after the parent attack lands
The ordinary main-hand strike deals native damage
The ordinary off-hand strike deals native damage
DISCRIMINATING: Azzinoth's Assault extends Inner Demon by at least the DBC's 3000ms base
